creatures.name: Frost Wight
creatures.quote:
“The cold does not kill you. It just waits.”
– Old northern saying
description: Frost wights are the frozen dead of the marches, risen when a blizzard lasts longer than the food. They drift over the snow with no footprints.
A wight will not stop while there is still warmth to take.

attacks.name: Rimed Claws
attacks.text: The wight rakes one target for D8 damage. The target is chilled and takes a bane on its next action.

attacks.name: Grave Chill
attacks.text: Everyone within 4 meters must make a WIL roll or become Scared.

attacks.name: Steal Warmth
attacks.text: The wight touches one target, dealing D6 damage that ignores armor, and heals the same amount.

attacks.name: Howl of the Marches
attacks.text: A freezing howl. All in sight take a bane on their next roll.

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.text: Immune to poison, sleep and fear. Takes double damage from fire.

creatures.adventure_seed: A caravan is stranded at a mountain pass. Every night one more wagon is found empty, and the snow around it is unmarked.
